changes.before: Under the NMC 2026 guidelines, the board rates you Eligible, Eligible with reasonable accommodation, or Ineligible for each speciality. For surgical specialities (Anaesthesiology, General Surgery, OBG, Ophthalmology, Orthopaedics, ENT, Traumatology, Emergency Medicine, PMR, Sports Medicine): Upper-limb disability and multiple disabilities are generally not suitable. Speech and language disability is not suitable. Lower-limb disability, and conditions such as cerebral palsy or muscular dystrophy, may be suitable if you show the needed functional competencies. Visual impairment is suitable only if corrective lenses alone bring it below 40%. Hearing impairment is suitable if you function with hearing aids or a cochlear implant and have acceptable, intelligible speech. Mental illness, ASD, SLD and ID are suitable if functional competency is present. Blood disorders are decided case by case. Chronic neurological conditions are suitable if stable, but not with uncontrolled seizures, frequent relapses, progressive neurodegeneration or severe impairment.
